heading_en: Transitional Measures for Qualifying Central Counterparties
summary_ja: 適用日から平成26年3月30日まで、新連結自己資本規制比率告示第1条第7号の3の「提供している者」を「提供している者又は提供しようとする者」と読み替える。
summary_en: From the Application Date until March 30, 2014, reads the definition of a Qualifying Central Counterparty to include a person that intends to provide the required information.
paragraphs: With respect to the application of Article 1, item (vii)-3 of the New Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio Notice during the period from the date of application of this Public Notice until March 30, 2014, the phrase "a person that provides" in that item is deemed to be replaced with "a person that provides or intends to provide."
